subject: CLAIM Gen7 secure/private provenance through cover-to-inner host migration
body: CURRENT_MAIN_SHA=633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44; ROLE=RESEARCH. Claiming a bounded Gen7 privacy/security lane: audit the Primary Gen7 core candidate plus current production integration seams for secure/private rendering provenance across one immutable cover->inner PresentationAttempt. Required invariants: protected pixels are never captured/materialized on private paths; provenance/secure state cannot be downgraded by prediction, staging, mirroring, outgoing-host retention, incoming-host activation, timeout/cancel, or stale generation callbacks; visual-only PresentationHinge data cannot authorize capture or host exposure; privacy state is attempt/host-fenced and fail-closed. This lane excludes host-migration timing/readiness semantics, predictor/reacquisition math, refresh-rate policy, diagnostics transport, and production integration. Cheapest decisive test: source trace of capture/SurfaceControl/mirror ownership + deterministic pure state model for privacy propagation/stale-callback attacks. No production Git writes.
